svg.title: WebPilot AI workflow
svg.desc: The Chrome extension extracts the page text and sends it to a FastAPI backend, which splits, embeds and indexes it; each question retrieves relevant chunks, builds a prompt and streams the answer back to the side panel.
svg.text: Chat with any web page, PDF or YouTube video · end-to-end workflow
① Index the page — once per page
② ③ Ask a question — every message
Per-page chat memory · request IDs on every log line · structured error envelope
chunks are searched in the index
